description: The agent skills of the focused project against a skill Catalog (bundles.yaml): up to date, outdated, missing and extra skills, with buttons to start, install, update, add and remove them through npx skills. A project without skills.yaml shows the skills that npx skills installed in it, by repository, and updates them without a Catalog. A toast offers to update outdated skills. Works in spaces on other machines too.

settings.label: Skill Catalog
settings.hint: Optional for projects without skills.yaml. The GitHub repository of your skill Catalog, as owner/name. It must have a bundles.yaml at its root. The mod clones it into ~/.config/herdr-app/cache/skill-bundles/ with gh (when you are logged in) or git.

settings.label: Your own clone (optional)
settings.hint: A folder with your own clone of the Catalog. The mod does not keep a clone of its own: it pulls your clone (git pull --ff-only) each time it fetches the Catalog, so your clone always stays up to date. When the clone has changes that are not committed or commits that are not pushed, the panel shows buttons to fix it (stash, discard, push, commit with an agent, or use a clone of the mod). On a branch that is not the default one, the mod installs from that branch, as Install-Skills.ps1 does.

settings.label: Clone URL (optional)
settings.hint: The URL for git clone when gh is not logged in, or when you want another URL. Empty: git@github.com:<owner>/<name>.git.

settings.label: Fetch the Catalog every
settings.hint: How often the mod fetches the Catalog (and runs npx skills check in a project without skills.yaml) to find outdated skills. The refresh button of the panel fetches at once.

settings.label: Offer to update outdated skills
settings.hint: When the mod finds Outdated skills in a project, it shows a toast once. A click on the toast updates them. A new set of Outdated skills shows a new toast.

settings.label: Shortcut of the Skill Bundles panel
settings.hint: Saved in keys.json. Opens the panel as a dialog. Only the status bar item listens for this command, so the key works in a layout with the status bar item.
